title: Victory Counter
description: Shared, always-visible tracks for any game system. Progress tracks count up to a target and complete there. Threshold tracks start at a value the GM sets, move up and down, and take their meaning from GM-described bands that can announce themselves in chat when crossed. Every player sees the same live state on screen. System-agnostic: the module stores its entire state in its own settings and never reads or writes any world document.
